introHtml: Full color decoration brings your brand to life on household essentials like aprons, oven mitts, and kitchen towels. Unlike single-color imprints, full color allows for detailed logos, gradients, and photographic images that make your giveaways feel premium. HR directors and marketing managers choose this option when they want everyday items that double as vibrant brand statements in the home.
